t: The hymn "Amazing Grace" was probably first used in a prayer meeting in Olney, England, without the music familiar to modern listeners.
On James Cook's second voyage, his vessel HMS Resolution became the first vessel to cross the Antarctic Circle.
Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart departed Italy after the last of his three journeys there.
The Polish Partition Sejm met to discuss the First Partition of Poland, carried out the previous year by Russia, Prussia and Austria.
French astronomer Charles Messier discovered the Whirlpool Galaxy, an interacting, grand design spiral galaxy located an estimated 31 million light-years away.
American Revolution: A group of colonists threw chests of tea into Boston Harbor to protest British taxation without representation.
